source_caption:
Snowfall follows Franklin Saint, a young man in Los Angeles whose life changes when he becomes involved in the emerging crack cocaine trade during the 1980s. As his business grows, Franklin gains wealth and power but also becomes entangled in violence, betrayal, and the devastating effects of the drug epidemic.

In Snowfall, multiple storylines connect street dealers, law enforcement, and international players involved in the drug trade. The show explores themes of ambition, corruption, family, and the social impact of crime. Known for its intense storytelling, strong performances, and historical backdrop, it became one of the most acclaimed modern crime dramas.
